items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: Manuel Perez is a national trumpet player.

ctx.x: How did Manuel Perez play? Manuel Perez? Yeah. I never got to hear him.

Manuel Perez is a national trumpet player. He's... under the fact. Very sweet trumpet player. Excellent trumpet player.
